title.narrative: Engaging Nigerian Diaspora and National Volunteers to Develop Civil Society

description.narrative: The problem: Although the GoN has introduced major initiatives to improve key SRH indicators (such as the uptake of appropriate child spacing methods), there are significant concerns related to the fact that, (i) non State actors (especially in marginalised and vulnerable communities) often lack the capacity to make effective contributions to State (whose limited capacity often requires strong partnerships with civil society) initiatives, and, (ii) no mechanisms exist through which the expertise of the Diaspora and national volunteers can be harnessed to strengthen civil society health organisations. What is the project going to do: (i) working with stakeholders, identify the most marginalised and vulnerable communities in northern Nigeria in terms of SR health care, (ii) map the organisational capacity of appropriate civil society health organisations within the target area, and, (iii) research and design mechanisms through which Diaspora and national volunteer expertise can be engaged to build the institutional capacity of civil society health organisations What will the result be: a practical, scalable, credible and cost effective Model aimed at engaging Diaspora and national volunteer expertise to enhance the institutional capacity of civil society SRH organisations which support State initiatives in the most vulnerable and marginalised communities of northern Nigeria
